name: qs
description: A querystring parser that supports nesting and arrays, with a depth limit

scripts.pretest: npm run --silent readme && npm run --silent lint
scripts.postlint: eclint check $(git ls-files | xargs find 2> /dev/null | grep -vE 'node_modules|\.git' | grep -v dist/)
scripts.dist: mkdirp dist && browserify --standalone Qs -g unassertify -g @browserify/envify -g [@browserify/uglifyify --mangle.keep_fnames --compress.keep_fnames --format.indent_level=1 --compress.arrows=false --compress.passes=4 --compress.typeofs=false] -p common-shakeify -p bundle-collapser/plugin lib/index.js > dist/qs.js
